source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
Once per turn, during your Movement phase, as this model begins or finishes a move, pick:

- 1 **WRAITH CONSTRUCT** unit of yours within 6" of it, other than a **TITANIC** unit
- 1 enemy unit this model can see

Until your next Movement phase starts, that friendly unit’s models have **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)** on their weapons while they target that enemy unit.
